free.title: Free up space

confirm.title: Free up space now?
confirm.lead: Cleanup by the current retention periods, the same one that runs every hour. It will delete:
confirm.capped: Counting stops at {{n}}. Where there are more records, the run deletes as many as it can, scheduled cleanup removes the rest.

reason.on_write: capped on write, nothing piles up

confirm.audit: The audit log is never cleaned manually. Retention periods are changed in Data retention.
confirm.nothing: Nothing to delete right now: everything past its retention period is already gone.
confirm.loadFailed: Could not count what would be deleted.

free.done_one: Done: {{rows}} record deleted, {{size}} freed on disk.
free.done_other: Done: {{rows}} records deleted, {{size}} freed on disk.
free.cancelled_one: Stopped: {{rows}} record deleted, {{size}} freed on disk.
free.cancelled_other: Stopped: {{rows}} records deleted, {{size}} freed on disk.
free.error_one: Cleanup finished with errors: {{rows}} record deleted, {{size}} freed on disk.
free.error_other: Cleanup finished with errors: {{rows}} records deleted, {{size}} freed on disk.
free.doneMore: Some records will be deleted by the next scheduled cleanup.
free.doneNote: Records deleted from tables free space inside the database for new records. Database files only shrink when a whole partition is dropped.
free.interrupted: The run was interrupted: the server restarted. What was deleted before that is gone, scheduled cleanup will remove the rest.

more.title: Where else to free up space
more.lead: What is cleaned in other sections and what this cleanup leaves out.
more.data: Data retention: periods and cleanup per source
more.runners: Runner disks: {{size}} can be freed on shared runners
more.runnersClean: Runner disks: nothing to free on shared runners
more.runnersNone: Runners do not report their disks yet: update them to {{version}}.
more.runnersNoReport: Runners have not sent a disk measurement yet.
more.outdated_one: {{n}} more runner does not report its disk: update it to {{version}}.
more.outdated_other: {{n}} more runners do not report their disks: update them to {{version}}.
more.runnersFailed: Could not load the runner disk summary.
more.notIncluded: Background cleanups are not included: unreferenced files, orphans, the project bin and expired sessions are cleaned on their own schedule. Images on Kubernetes nodes are removed by Kubernetes itself when a node runs low on space.
